nodes.label: examples/ Axis (Syntax & Library Extensibility)
nodes.rationale: Pre-installed and user-authored .meme files in examples/ serve as the live syntax/idiom bank; examples/ must remain curated and free of test clutter, which is why the corpus lives strictly under tests/corpus/

nodes.label: examples/ Axis (Syntax & Library Extensibility)
nodes.rationale: examples/ (including pre-installed CS 101-103 library under examples/cs101/, cs102/, cs103/) acts as the language's living syntax and idiom bank - 'Memelang is as smart as you make it' - so adding new idiomatic patterns teaches the language new phrasing conventions

nodes.label: src/ Language Axis (IR & Output Target Extensibility)
nodes.norm_label: src/ language axis (ir & output target extensibility)
nodes.rationale: The typed IR (src/memelang/ir/), static verifier (src/memelang/analyzer/), and codegen backends (src/memelang/codegen/) define core computational primitives and target languages (python, rust, cpp)

nodes.label: Local-First Hardware Target (6GB VRAM)
nodes.rationale: Designed to run comfortably on consumer hardware with 6GB VRAM (e.g. GTX 1660 running 1.5B-3B quantized models such as qwen2.5-coder:3b via Ollama/llama.cpp), with a built-in zero-dependency heuristic engine for offline usage - this motivates the provider abstraction and fallback design

nodes.label: Memelang Natural Language Compiler Design Spec
nodes.norm_label: memelang natural language compiler design spec

nodes.label: LLM Frontend Only / Deterministic Backends
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 (English -> JSON IR) uses a schema-constrained LLM at T=0.0 seed 42; Phase 2 (IR -> Python/Rust/C++20) is 100% deterministic and never invokes the LLM, so rebuilds via build.lock have 0ms LLM latency and are fully reproducible

nodes.label: Fail-Safe Ambiguity Detection
nodes.rationale: When English phrasing is semantically ambiguous or contradictory the compiler halts before code generation, presents numbered candidate interpretations with canonical English equivalents, and locks the resolution into build.lock via --resolve or --interactive instead of silently guessing

nodes.label: CS 101-103 Stress Corpus & 2-Axis Gap Harness Design Spec
nodes.norm_label: cs 101-103 stress corpus & 2-axis gap harness design spec

nodes.label: Temporary Lockfile Isolation
nodes.rationale: Running scripts/run_corpus.py must use a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory for LockfileManager so ./build.lock in the repo root is never created, read, or mutated during corpus evaluation

nodes.label: src/ Language Axis (IR & Output Target Extensibility)
nodes.norm_label: src/ language axis (ir & output target extensibility)
nodes.rationale: The typed IR, static verifier, and code generators determine structural operations and target output languages (python, rust, cpp, and future backends)
